text:
Situation: Carbamazepine 200 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 70 tablets (9.2 days), Corvale General holds 153 tablets (19.9 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 26 tablets (14.1 days). A rule-based transfer of 37 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East would leave Corvale General with about two weeks of supply and raise Corvale East to 14 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include carbamazepine as of 2026-10-21. The product used at both Corvale sites (NDC 72603088701) is labeled by Northstar Rx LLC and manufactured at Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260) in India. FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2015-10-09, 2019-07-05, and 2024-03-29, with the most recent known date of 2024-05-13. A separate FDA posting notes Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. plans to discontinue carbamazepine extended-release capsules (NDC 54092-171-12) with an initial posting date of 2025-12-19, but this is a different dosage form and manufacturer. Alternate manufacturers Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, and Apotex Corp. are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place for inspection review.

Our position: Current inventory supports a short-term internal transfer to balance supply across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists for the tablet formulation we use. Alternate sources lack verifiable manufacturing site information for quality assessment.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 37 tablets of 200 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Evaluate alternate manufacturers (Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Apotex Corp.) for potential procurement — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
